# SUPER GREEDY

> Automated futures trading software for ES, NQ, MES, and MNQ.

Super Greedy runs one Trend detection strategy across live futures charts and executes it automatically, submitting the entry with its stop loss and take profit and managing the position to the exit. Traders configure sessions, bias, contracts, timeframe, exit type, and max stop loss; the strategy itself is fixed. Desktop apps: macOS and Windows.
